newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar nudges higher, spread trade cited.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar nudges higher, spread trade cited.

text.p: White sugar futures pushed marginally higher on Wednesday afternoon but much of the day's turnover derived from the nearby August/October spread, market sources said.
While New York's July/October spread was once again a focus of interest, both markets put in a lacklustre performance with tight price movements, they said.
In London, August/October came under trade scale-down buying pressure as it narrowed to under $6.00 and the two front months dominated the overall volume of 984 lots.
"There is pressure on the whites...it's mostly spread activity rather than direct volume," said one trader.
At 1530 GMT August was up 40 cents at $323.60 and October up 70 cents at $317.70. Other traded positions were a touch firmer.
Traders said the August/July arbitrage was quiet as most players were already turning their attention to the further forward differentials, such as October which was valued at around $67.
Volume in Paris was confined to 323 lots, mostly in August. The contract was up $1.00 at $323.50.
